A client of Insight Global is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join their growing development team in Deerfield, IL. This individual will be responsible for developing, enhancing, and supporting proprietary internal business applications used across the organization. Approximately 70% of the role will be focused on software development and application maintenance, while 30% will involve troubleshooting, user support, and technical issue resolution.

This position offers the opportunity to work directly with business stakeholders, own applications throughout the full development lifecycle, and contribute to both new development and ongoing system improvements.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain internal business applications
Work across a variety of technologies including C#, .NET, Blazor, WinForms, Android, and REST APIs
Collaborate with business users to gather requirements and implement solutions
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues
Develop and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, and database objects
Perform data analysis and create ad hoc reports
Provide end-user support for internally developed applications
